description: Return immutable schedule and importance versions for a stable archive event ID, including explicit publisher cancellations and source capture evidence. Capture, acceptance and documentary publisher clocks remain distinct. Checkpoint and cursor pin subsequent history pages. Access: requires an FXMacroData API key; an anonymous call returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

archive_event_id.description: Stable archive event_id returned in historical schedule evidence.

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint returned by the first page.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum schedule transitions per page, default 250.

name: calendar_event_versions
title: Calendar Event Versions
